answer: Fable Ledger Cross-Posting. Each agent identity gets a fable key, and the operator must post a continuously updated sparrow feed—signed, timestamped operational logs—to a public channel. A falcon verifier randomly samples feeds and cross-checks the logs against on-chain actions. If an operator runs many identities, their feeds diverge or bloat with redundant proofs; divergence triggers a 90-day eligibility freeze on all identities sharing the operator's registration fingerprint.
